expectation: Membrane/cell-surface ring on a subset of CD68+ macrophages (M2-like), scattered single cells or clusters in stroma/aggregates, absent from tumour/epithelial nuclei-dense areas; moderate abundance.
observed: A: many ROIs show discrete yellow cell-sized stained cells, varying strongly by ROI; some nearly empty. B/C: sparse yellow in nuclei-rich areas, dim. D: yellow rings around blue nuclei. E: crisp membrane rings on cell clusters that overlap CD68 magenta, with CD163-negative tissue dark.
why: Membrane-ring CD163 on cell clusters co-localising with CD68, patchy across ROIs and absent from nuclei-dense areas, as expected for macrophages.
